notes.title: Small fixes and changes
notes.content:
Patch Notes V1.1

-Customiser menu has new images for the player model select
-Removed all remaining back facing vending machines
-Delivery zone size increased
-Added arrow above package when not held
-Occulsion sphere size increased
-Car physics improved
-Added credits behind the counter inside the Burger Zombie restaurant
-Disabled delivery zones for out of bounds buildings
-Improved player collision
-Customiser UI fix
-Hid the delivery arrow in the tutorial level
-Tutorial level default zoom altered
-First room in tutorial level altered for improved visibility
-Cursor now passes beneath zombies
-Restart button on pause menu restarts you to current level
-Game window name fixed
-Print statments removed
-Large Building type had delivery zone lowered to correct height
-Minor level edits
-Minor UI edits
-Minor bug fixes
